name: Dragonmurk
summary: In southern Dustwallow Marsh, black dragonspawn and hatchlings swarm Dragonmurk. Ancient ogre ruins and scorched caverns flank this dangerous tract, held by Onyxia's brood.

sections.title: A Brood in the Bog
sections.body: In southern Dustwallow Marsh, wet paths and thick mud teem with black wyrmkins, dragonspawn, and hungry whelps. The black dragonflight holds the land around Dragonmurk. Stonemaul, a ruined village, and the scorched Den of Flame both lie under its control.

sections.title: Guarding the Broodmother
sections.body: Onyxia's black dragonspawn fill the mire, guarding her clutch. Southern Dustwallow is Onyxia's main nesting ground in Kalimdor. She is the daughter of Deathwing. Her wyrmkin patrol the marsh and destroy intruders, protecting the eggs from Theramore's scouts and nearby Horde camps.

faq.answer: Dragonmurk is a southern stretch of Dustwallow Marsh overrun by black dragonflight whelps, drakes, and dragonspawn.

faq.q: Why are there so many black dragons here?
faq.answer: Onyxia's lair lies in southern Dustwallow Marsh, where her offspring and servants nest, grow, and keep outside threats at bay.

faq.q: What landmarks are found near Dragonmurk?
faq.answer: The Den of Flame and the Stonemaul Ruins lie in and around Dragonmurk. Black dragonspawn occupy both.
No. Hostile, aggressive dragonkin make Dragonmurk one of southern Kalimdor's most perilous wilderness regions.

angles.text: Black dragons drove the Stonemaul ogres from their village. They still threaten Horde expeditions that venture deep into the marsh.
Theramore watches Dragonmurk closely. An unchecked black dragon brood so near the fortress could spell disaster.
